name: lilylavender
description: Lily's Claude Code workflow skills: plan-first gate, execute-plan build step, ship chain, open-items scan, and scoped testing checklists.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: The plan -> build -> ship chain: /plan-first asks clarifying questions and gates on explicit approval, /execute-plan builds the approved plan with branch and commit choices made up front, /ship commits, pushes, merges to main and deploys.

plugins.name: open-items
plugins.description: Scans the current project for what is still outstanding: unfinished plan items, uncommitted or unmerged git state, and loose threads from the conversation.

plugins.name: testing-checklist
plugins.description: Produces a short manual-test checklist scoped to what a specific non-trivial change could plausibly break, skipping anything already verified.
